name: program-runtime.batch-inference
purpose: Classify up to 32 texts through ai-gateway.classify-batch and propagate ordered validated labels, partial failures, usage and child artifact evidence.

corpus.description: Texts to classify, 1 to 32. Default: three failure sentences.

labels.description: Closed label set rendered into the enum schema.

instruction.description: Caller-owned classification instruction passed to the shared workflow.

assumptions: ai-gateway is running with a provider that serves classify.fast
invariants: One nested classification workflow; at most one governed batch RPC.
Only validated in-set labels are counted; failed child evidence remains failed.
The envelope is printed exactly once on every path.

signals.results: Ordered item evidence, including null labels and indexed errors for failures.
signals.labels: Labels in input order, null for invalid or absent results.
signals.usage: Owner-supplied batch usage; null when unavailable or invalid.

outputs.evidence: Shared workflow evidence and child artifact digest/version.
